authority.rule: Do not delete failing or missing requirements from the fixed measured scenario.

target.onDevicePortability: Coordinates come from each fresh viewport and node; another authorized OPPO device requires the same fixture and observed picker contract, not an inferred equivalence.

properties.serial: Explicit authorized Android serial, matching ScriptSpec target.serial.
properties.outputDir: Absolute existing screenshot output directory unique to this run. Host recordingDir is separately required on start.

runtime.recordingDir: Required at script start; fresh directory; no reopening existing recording.
runtime.mutations: No blind retries. Reobserve without mutation while awaiting declared page conditions; every further scroll requires fresh confirmed movement.
runtime.deviceIO: Only ctx.call, no arbitrary host/ADB/process/file scripting in the worker.
runtime.appTap: Before every app tap, read-only wait for the exact unique target with complete node and actionable bounds inside the current viewport, across advancing stable SDK generations. Re-resolve from the final qualifying tree; convert current tap.bounds center using current validated DPR. Explicit app package must return transport=bridge; stop without mutation retry on any different transport.
runtime.systemPickerTap: Current unique UIA physical bounds; explicit com.coloros.filemanager plus feedback=off deliberately dispatches ADB input.
runtime.scrollObservation: A changed stable tree must contain a current unique scrollable content Text anchor or the actual destination. A navigation-only transition tree cannot authorize another swipe. Subsequent anchors are uniquely topmost/leftmost among current individually unique text nodes, never reused IDs.

scrollRoutes.settings: Explicit observed physical swipe using current scroll bounds and DPR.
scrollRoutes.about: Explicit primary scroll-flutter delta=min(450,current visible logical scroll extent*0.6), preceded by one unique matching SingleChildScrollView assertion. One action per observed movement; no scrollUntilText or fallback.

runtime.flutterObservationStability: Require exact relevant label/node/tap/scroll geometry and viewport to match across distinct advancing finite positive SDK updatedAtMs values. Different Host observation IDs for one cached generation are insufficient. Wait read-only up to 10 seconds; missing, regressed or nonadvancing generations remain inconclusive.

fixture.initialExternalOracle: Controller must read allowlisted run-as preferences and prove exact baseline before start.
fixture.finalExternalOracle: Controller must independently read final preferences after terminal and compare exact allowlisted map with initial.

setupBranches.trigger: Fresh Chinese Receive fixture and all three exact NavigationDestination nodes observed
Receive fixture absent or current UI differs
setupBranches.action: Return/report inconclusive. No frozen application onboarding/permission actions are supplied; controller must freeze an explicit setup branch before replay.

settingsScrollGeometry.baseline: Captured from this run initial settings-top-baseline full flutter-nodes observation.
settingsScrollGeometry.restoration: Every one of the 16 current edges must differ from its retained baseline by strictly less than 0.5 logical pixel before settings-scroll-restored checkpoint; visible System rows alone are insufficient.
settingsScrollGeometry.comparison: Math.abs(currentEdge - baselineEdge) < 0.5; strict for every edge.

evidenceRules.pageAssertions: Each page and target assertion uses the unchanged evidence from its current read before the next mutation.
evidenceRules.screenshots: Fresh current-run screenshots with returned hashes and nearby trees; separate captures, never described as atomic.
evidenceRules.mobile: Immediately before the declared mutation, request each stream with sinceMs=Date.now()-1000 and limit=200; require complete committed gap-free hasMore=false current watermark/epoch/target. Refresh UI selector, mutate once, query same stream using that factCursor, runtimeEpoch and afterActionId. Retain unavailable/missing/partial/unbound facts as nonpassing mobile assertions. Picker package cannot establish app-local capture association. Existence is separate from business semantics.
evidenceRules.archive: Opt-in recording plus public evidence export(includeRecordedPayloads=true), separately pinned manifest SHA256, separate offline MCP evidence verify. Retain failed runs.
evidenceRules.snapshotIdentity: Retain each qualifying snapshot pair with SDK updatedAtMs, both Host observation IDs and evidence references under stableObservations. Current ctx.assert receives unchanged latest evidence; Host call identity does not prove a new Flutter generation.

timing.source: Host per-run timings and controller terminal timestamps; Script result.wallMs is supplemental.
timing.interpretation: These are gates to measure, not achieved results.

requiredExternalGates.requirement: Explicit network/peer precondition and reliable oracle for the no-peer/empty discovery scenario.
requiredExternalGates.available: Repeated fresh UI DevicePlaceholderListTile plus screenshots.
requiredExternalGates.missing: No network isolation or discovery completeness evidence; empty file selection is not an empty peer list.

requiredExternalGates.requirement: Key business-correlated state/events/logs and screenshot evidence for navigation/cancel/settings outcomes.
requiredExternalGates.missing: Frozen action-filtered event pages are empty. No reliable business predicates or Rust transport coverage contract supplied. Script retains fresh capture calls/assertions and leaves this gate open.

requiredExternalGates.requirement: Fresh final allowlisted preferences equal the controller-verified initial map exactly.
requiredExternalGates.interpretation: A Script checkpoint or returned expectedSettings object is not the oracle.

verdictRules.uiReplayPassed: Every UI/page/selector/screenshot assertion passed and flowCompleted=true.
verdictRules.fullScenarioPassed: UI replay passed, applicable changed/restored/final independent oracles passed, every external gate marked requiredInThisScenario resolved with current evidence, archive verified, timing gate met.
verdictRules.negative: Deliberately wrong business expectation must produce a failed ctx.assert from fresh tree; execution may still be completed because the worker returns the recorded failure.
